Bengaluru Police Investigate Murder, Exhume Minor Girl's Body

Bengaluru police have exhumed the body of a minor girl as part of an investigation into a murder in Kanakapura. Reports indicate a minor allegedly shot her live-in partner and, with the help of relatives, buried the body. The investigation is ongoing.
